fields.help: Locally-installed agent runtime id — claude, codex, kimicode, qwen, … (list: monoagentcli agent scan --installed), or auto to pick a validated one from the agent roster (monoagentcli agent validate).
fields.label: Agent Runtime

fields.help: Falls back to the runtime's default model.
fields.label: Model

fields.help: Ask for JSON matching this schema (type, required, properties, items, enum are checked). The parsed value goes under Output Key; a mismatch is re-asked once, then fails the item.
fields.label: Output Schema (JSON Schema)

fields.help: With an output schema and an object answer, also copy its fields onto the item.
fields.label: Merge Output Into Item

fields.help: How many items run at once. Output keeps the input order.
fields.label: Concurrency

fields.help: Remember the conversation: each item's turn sees the last window messages (default 10; 0 = all) of its session (session_key, resolved per item, default {{ $json.sessionId }}) and is added to it afterwards. "skip_when_missing": true runs an item without a session key as a fresh conversation instead of failing it. Read or edit a session with the agent.memory node. Leave empty (or set "enabled": false) for no memory.
fields.label: Conversation Memory
